issue.detail: Spec says capture when input changes 1->0; rule uses bitwise prev_in & ~in. Alternative semantics: capture only when whole vector transitions from all-ones to all-zeros.
issue.spec_evidence: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
issue.alternative: Capture only when entire 32-bit vector goes from 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x00000000
